Create one photorealistic premium editorial contact sheet as a perfectly square 4:4 canvas containing EXACTLY 16 separate equal square photographs in a precise 4-column by 4-row grid. Full bleed edge-to-edge with direct clean boundaries between square photos: NO gutters, borders, gridlines, labels, text, typography, logos, watermark, collage overlap, or extra panels. Every cell must independently read as a square crop with generous breathing room. Maintain one consistent product type in every panel: a classic six-panel baseball cap with curved brim and structured low/medium crown, in navy, cream, slate blue and muted neutral colors. Do not show any other hat style, socks, clothing, or unrelated products. The item shape must remain a conventional baseball cap with the curved brim clearly attached in the correct direction.

The 16 cells, row by row, must tell this exact style-specific production story, each as its own single square photograph:
Row 1: (1) a complete classic baseball cap on a clean studio plinth, construction overview; (2) close macro of the cap's panel seams, eyelets and a tiny unmarked generic embroidered geometric motif; (3) top-down sourcing brief tabletop with this baseball cap, matching fabric swatches and blank cards; (4) gloved hands measuring this cap's crown and curved brim with a soft measuring tape.
Row 2: (5) hands carefully sampling this baseball cap's fabric and brim; (6) close quality inspection of baseball-cap stitching and brim seam; (7) hands neatly packing this cap in tissue; (8) this cap inside an open premium presentation box.
Row 3: (9) this cap alone inside a clear protective bag; (10) this cap arranged beside an unmarked kraft mailer; (11) a blank hangtag and blank insert beside this cap, absolutely no legible writing; (12) considered still life of two baseball caps in coordinating colors and folded fabric, generic unmarked details.
Row 4: (13) tasteful retail display of several classic baseball caps only; (14) coordinated team-color lineup of classic baseball caps only; (15) high-end ecommerce hero photo of one complete baseball cap on warm off-white; (16) another ecommerce product photo of the same classic baseball cap viewed from a complementary angle.
